metric: L4 reward/approach arm (NEX5_APPROACH) — bounded positive readiness term on world-contact
signal: p_on_subject over the last 30 fires (subject_fidelity: fraction of fires sharing >=1 content token with their focal_item)
frozen_by: manual measurement this session (NEX running); re-freeze before reuse — rates go stale

reward_params_frozen.onset_basis: 30-fire-window p75 (top-quartile grounding; NOT the mean, per Beam A3; NOT the daily p75 0.676 which engaged ~46%)
reward_params_frozen.bonus_max_basis: PROVISIONAL — Beam 1c calibration (> readiness noise floor, < ~half smallest decision margin) is the principled bound; 0.10 < smallest existing readiness term pending that measurement

feasibility_simulation.method: 30-fire window slid over the 14d history; bonus = f(window p_on_subject)
feasibility_simulation.verdict: PASS — engages only in clearly-above-baseline grounding (~19% duty), silent otherwise. A positive, bounded mattering-term.

mechanism_premise_CONFIRMED.meaning: grounding PERSISTS fire-to-fire, so 'fire more when recently grounded' can raise the grounded FRACTION — the reward is non-tautological and has real leverage.

scope_finding_ORTHOGONALITY.corr_note_reject_rate: p_on_subject is also flat against crystallizer reject rate (~1.0-1.2/fire regardless of grounding)
scope_finding_ORTHOGONALITY.meaning: Grounding is ORTHOGONAL to grooming and to reject rate on live. This arm reshapes the GROUNDING mix; it does NOT target grooming (a separate axis for a later selection-coupling node, L4b). Pre-registered as a prediction: r80 will raise grounded fraction and will NOT move groove/fire.

independent_primary_for_round.primary: grounded fraction (p_on_subject) at CONSTANT cadence (Beam 1a: ratio + cadence co-primary)
independent_primary_for_round.why_not_an_external_metric: grounding predicts no independent downstream outcome on live (orthogonal to grooming and reject rate), so the honest primary is the ratio itself, de-cadenced by the co-primary; non-tautological per the +0.379 autocorrelation
